snippet.title: Blightveil — Pre-Alpha Gameplay Trailer [EN]
snippet.description:
Introducing the gameplay trailer for Blightveil — a new game by Grim Guys!

Blightveil is an Action-MOBA with WASD movement and a NON-Target aiming system —
a world of relentless combat where the genre unfolds in a new way!
Experience dynamic arena battles where two teams of four players fight for one goal — to become champions.

Add Blightveil to your Steam wishlist today!
✅  https://store.steampowered.com/app/3525500/Blightveil
You can also apply to join the upcoming playtest.

The playtest date will be announced very soon — follow us on social media so you don’t miss the news!

Social media:
Discord: https://discord.gg/dgY8PfkUe6
Twitch: https://twitch.tv/blightveil
Reddit: https://www.reddit.com/r/Blightveil
TikTok: https://tiktok.com/@blightveil_game
X: https://twitter.com/grimguysstudio  

//Grim Guys Studio
#Blightveil #gameplay #steam #pc #ggs #grimguysstudio #grimguys
